WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) FAQ

What frequency is WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) on?
In the A-26 season WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) is scheduled on 4 shortwave frequencies, including 2500, 5000, 10000, 15000 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 10000 kHz (24 hours a day). For Europe: 10000 kHz (24 hours a day).

Can I hear WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) in the USA?
Yes. WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) is beamed at North America this season on 2500, 5000, 10000, 15000 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 10000 kHz (24 hours a day).

Does WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. WWVH Hawaii (f.ann.) is scheduled in Time Signal.
